summary: Feed s122_double to NDR is degraded: VLAN 20 missing (50% packets untagged) and encrypted share 93.5% exceeds 90% tolerance, reducing NDR detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 tags are being stripped upstream - likely packet broker configured to strip 802.1Q or SPAN not preserving tags - causing 50% of packets to arrive untagged where VLAN 20 is expected.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation context; without VLAN 20 it cannot correlate traffic per segment, apply VLAN-aware policies, or detect lateral movement and segmentation violations.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLAN 20 through TAP/packet broker so NDR receives complete VLAN context for detection.

findings.root_cause: 93.5% of bytes are encrypted (TLS), above NDR tolerance of 90%; traffic is forwarded opaque without broker-based decryption or key sharing.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for DPI and anomaly detection; high encrypted share blinds content inspection, limiting detection to metadata only and missing C2, exfiltration and exploit payloads.

recommended_fix.why: Selectively decrypt or provide session keys/metadata at the packet broker to bring encrypted share below 90% and restore payload visibility for NDR.
